mods.name: TACZ Scope Zeroing
mods.description: Adds per-scope angle adjustment to TaCZ guns. Hold a gun and use your arrow keys to adjust pitch (up/down) and yaw (left/right) to compensate for bullet drop and dial in long-range shots.

releases.notes:
## TACZ Scope Zeroing v1.6.0

### Changes
- Lock and Reset keys are now proper Minecraft keybindings in the Controls menu
- Default Lock key: apostrophe key, Default Reset key: semicolon key
- Both appear under the TACZ Scope Zeroing category
- Players can rebind both keys through the vanilla keybinds screen
- Removed hardcoded GLFW config entries (no longer needed)

mods.name: TACZ Trajectory Offset
mods.description: Modifies TACZ bullet trajectory with arrow key vertical angle offset.

releases.notes:
## TACZ Trajectory Offset v1.5.0

### Fixes
- **True per-instance scope offsets**: Offset data is now stored directly on each scope ItemStack's NBT tag
- Two identical scopes (e.g. two ACOGs from creative) now maintain completely independent offset values
- Swapping a specific scope between guns preserves that scope's unique offsets

### How it works
Each scope item instance carries its own pitch and yaw offset in its NBT data (\	acz0ing_pitch\ / \	acz0ing_yaw\). Since each ItemStack has its own independent NBT tag, even identical scope types are fully isolated.

### Note
Offsets are stored on the scope item itself. Dropping or trading a scope transfers its zeroing data with it.

releases.notes:
## TACZ Trajectory Offset v1.4.0

### Fixes
- HUD display now only appears when an offset key is actually pressed, not passively while holding a gun
- Display fades out over 1.5s after last adjustment then hides completely
- \/tacz0ing toggle\ still suppresses display entirely when disabled

### Behavior
- Press any arrow key -> display appears at full opacity
- Stop pressing -> display fades out over 1.5 seconds
- After fade -> display hidden until next adjustment
- Toggle disabled -> no display at all

mods.name: TACZ Trajectory Offset
mods.description: Modifies TACZ bullet trajectory with arrow key vertical angle offset.

releases.notes:
## TACZ Trajectory Offset v1.3.0

### Changes
- **Reset key remapped**: R -> ; (semicolon). Configurable via \config/tacz0ing-common.toml\
- **Scope-specific offsets**: Offset values are now stored per-scope. Swapping a scope between guns preserves its zeroing adjustments.

### Key Bindings (holding a TACZ gun)
| Key | Action |
|-----|--------|
| UP/DOWN | Pitch offset +/- 0.01 |
| LEFT/RIGHT | Yaw offset +/- 0.01 |
| L | Toggle lock (freezes offsets) |
| ; | Reset both pitch and yaw to 0 |
| \/tacz0ing toggle\ | Show/hide HUD display |

### Config
\\\	oml
[tacz0ing]
  # GLFW key code for the lock key (default 76 = L)
  lockKey=76
  # GLFW key code for the reset key (default 59 = semicolon ;)
  resetKey=59
\\\

### How scope-specific offsets work
Each scope (ACOG, Vudu, T1, etc.) maintains its own independent pitch and yaw offset values. When you swap a scope from one gun to another, all zeroing adjustments are preserved. Offsets are stored per-scope on the player's data and auto-sync between client and server.
